carbon_market_reference._note: Carbon pricing benchmarks from Africa Blue Carbon Initiative Stakeholder Brief, Feb 2026 (GUD / African Union Commission). Applicable as reference tiers for any carbon credit valuation attached to Serious Shea scope emissions reductions.
carbon_market_reference._context: Shea parklands are part of the Sahel agroforestry corridor — the same landscape as the Great Green Wall (GGW). Carbon sequestration from shea tree preservation and restoration shares the same voluntary and compliance markets as the blue carbon and GGW programmes. The Africa Blue Carbon Initiative explicitly integrates blue carbon into National Development Contributions (NDCs) across its 7 member states, several of which overlap with the shea belt (Guinea, West Africa generally).

3.name: Processing (nuts to butter)
3.notes: Serious Shea: 100% renewable energy. 925 kg butter/woman/season. BAU uses 20 kg firewood/kg butter — driving deforestation. CO₂e reduction: >95% vs BAU.

conversion_bags_per_MT.note: Whole fruits or kernels; ambiguity in source.

3.scope_source: Clarity/Cleo Value Chain Outline; Serious Shea BPlan V8 2023 — Serious Shea scenario (baseline)
3.scope_notes: Serious Shea scenario: 100% renewable processing. Residual S1 from generator backup and delivery transport.
3.scope_bau_note: BAU: 10.374 kg CO₂e/kg butter (firewood combustion). Serious Shea: <0.5187 kg CO₂e/kg (>95% reduction). Source: Clarity/Cleo outline.
3.water_source: Inferred — shea processing food science benchmarks; Olawale et al. (2020) ~5-10 L/kg butter
3.water_notes: Boiling, washing, and phase separation in butter rendering. Traditional ~10 L/kg; Serious Shea mechanical ~5 L/kg. Limited recycling in field operations.
3.energy_source: Serious Shea BPlan V8 2023; Clarity/Cleo outline — Serious Shea scenario (100% renewable target)
3.energy_notes: Serious Shea: 100% renewable mechanical processing (electric mills, solar/biogas). BAU: firewood = 88 kWh/kg butter, 0% clean. 80% reflects near-target Serious Shea operational state.
